name: Apathy - Psycho Fujoshi
original_name: アパシーサイコ腐女子
source:
A new story in the Apathy series set at Narugami Academy, an institution inhabited not only by monsters and supernatural entities, but also by psychopaths and deeply broken individuals. 

The story follows Anzai Haruto, a womanizer who treats girls as disposable, until he meets Senba Maria, a mysterious classmate unlike anyone he has known before. Fascinated by her, Haruto becomes drawn into a terrifying nightmare that marks the beginning of his personal hell.
translation:
《冷漠》系列的新故事以鸣神学院为背景，这所学院不仅居住着怪物和超自然实体，还居住着精神病患者和深深破碎的人。

故事讲述的是安西晴人，一个视女孩为可抛弃物的好色之徒，直到他遇到了千场玛丽亚，一个与他以前所认识的人不同的神秘同学。晴人对她着迷，陷入了一场可怕的噩梦，这标志着他个人地狱的开始。
